subject.title: docs: clarify ClawSweeper review and proof flow

question: Should OpenClaw document the current narrow `docs/**` proof exemption, or should maintainers first broaden ClawSweeper’s proof policy to cover test-only and behavior-neutral changes?
rationale: The proposed wording creates a contributor-facing policy contract that is broader than current automated enforcement, so the permanent proof boundary requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical edit assumption.

options.title: Match Current Gate
options.body: Narrow all three additions to the existing `docs/**`-only exemption and retain proof or explicit override requirements for other external PRs.

options.title: Broaden ClawSweeper First
options.body: Sponsor and land the broader proof-exemption policy in ClawSweeper, then keep the proposed OpenClaw wording once enforcement matches it.

recommendation.title: Match Current Gate
recommendation.body: Narrow all three additions to the existing `docs/**`-only exemption and retain proof or explicit override requirements for other external PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects steipete to both the root review policy and the original external-PR proof requirement.
